ei.title: Noise Complaint About Basketball Court Hours
ei.subject: 11월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Noise Complaint About Basketball Court Hours

fullPassage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I struggle to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I appreciate your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an (A)[ongoing / temporary] noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully (B)[support / ignore] the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I struggle to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is (C)[affected / restricted] by this noise issue. I appreciate your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② ongoing — support — affected: 원문 일치. 지속되는(ongoing) 소음 문제, 서비스를 지지(support)하지만, 소음에 영향받는(affected) 사람 ←정답

❌ ① restricted(제한된): affected(영향받는)의 의미와 다름

❌ ③ temporary(일시적인): ongoing(지속되는)의 반의어로 부적절

❌ ④ ignore(무시하다): support(지지하다)의 반의어로 부적절

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am (A)[experiencing / avoiding]. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being (B)[disrupted / welcomed] by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I struggle to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I (C)[appreciate / restrict] your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ③ experiencing — disrupted — appreciate: 원문 일치. 소음 문제를 겪고(experiencing), 방해받고(disrupted), 도움에 감사(appreciate) ←정답

❌ ① restrict(제한하다): appreciate(감사하다)와 다른 의미

❌ ② avoiding(피하는): experiencing(겪고 있는)의 반의어

❌ ④ welcomed(환영받는): disrupted(방해받는)의 반의어

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I (A)[struggle / manage] to fall asleep because I can hear people (B)[bouncing / catching] balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I appreciate your (C)[assistance / resistance]. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① struggle — bouncing — assistance: 원문 일치. 잠들기 위해 애쓰고(struggle), 공 튀기는(bouncing) 소리, 도움(assistance) 요청 ←정답

❌ ② manage(해내다): struggle(애쓰다)의 반의어 방향

❌ ③ catching(잡는): bouncing(튀기는)과 다른 동작

❌ ④ resistance(저항): assistance(도움)의 반의어

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to ①<u>inform</u> you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am ②<u>constantly</u> being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I ③<u>struggle</u> to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you ④<u>expand</u> the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I appreciate your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① inform(알리다): 소음 문제를 알리기 위해 편지를 쓴다는 맥락에 적절 ✅

② constantly(끊임없이): 지속적으로 방해받는다는 맥락에 적절 ✅

③ struggle(애쓰다): 잠들기 어렵다는 맥락에 적절 ✅

④ expand(확장하다): 농구 코트 이용 시간을 '제한해 달라'는 요청이므로 restrict(제한하다)가 적절. expand는 반의어로 부적절 ←정답

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment ①<u>faces</u> the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully ②<u>oppose</u> the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I struggle to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and ③<u>shouting</u> on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is ④<u>affected</u> by this noise issue. I appreciate your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① faces(향하다): 아파트가 농구 코트를 향하고 있다는 맥락에 적절 ✅

② oppose(반대하다): 문화 센터 서비스를 '전적으로 지지한다'는 맥락이므로 support(지지하다)가 적절. oppose는 반의어로 부적절 ←정답

③ shouting(소리치는): 농구 코트에서 소리치는 사람들 맥락에 적절 ✅

④ affected(영향받는): 소음에 영향받는 사람이라는 맥락에 적절 ✅

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am ①<u>experiencing</u>. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by ②<u>individuals</u> playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I struggle to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the ③<u>neighborhood</u> that is affected by this noise issue. I ④<u>resent</u> your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① experiencing(겪고 있는): 소음 문제를 겪고 있다는 맥락에 적절 ✅

② individuals(개인들): 밤늦게 농구하는 사람들이라는 맥락에 적절 ✅

③ neighborhood(근처): 이 근처에서 소음에 영향받는 사람이라는 맥락에 적절 ✅

④ resent(원망하다): 도움에 '감사한다'는 맥락이므로 appreciate(감사하다)가 적절. resent은 반의어로 부적절 ←정답

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being __________ by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I struggle to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I appreciate your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
문맥: 밤늦게 농구하는 사람들로 인해 '끊임없이 ____되고 있다'

✅ ① disrupted(방해받는): 소음으로 인해 방해받는다는 맥락에 적절 ←정답

❌ ② delighted(기쁜): 소음 불만 맥락과 반대

❌ ③ encouraged(격려받는): 소음 문제와 무관

❌ ④ entertained(즐거워하는): 소음 불만 맥락과 반대

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I appreciate your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
문맥: 농구 코트를 여는 시간을 밤 9시 이전으로 ____ 해 줄 수 있나요?

✅ ④ restrict(제한하다): 시간을 제한해 달라는 요청 맥락에 적절 ←정답

❌ ① extending(연장하다): 시간을 줄여달라는 요청의 반대

❌ ② promoting(홍보하다): 코트 이용 시간과 무관

❌ ③ monitoring(감시하다): 시간 제한 요청과 다른 의미

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I struggle to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I appreciate your __________. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
문맥: 당신의 ____ 에 감사드립니다.

✅ ③ assistance(도움): 'I appreciate your assistance'에서 도움에 감사한다는 맥락에 적절 ←정답

❌ ① apartment(아파트): 감사 대상으로 부자연스러움

❌ ② basketball(농구): 불만 대상이므로 감사 맥락과 모순

❌ ④ community(공동체): 문맥상 '도움'이 더 적절

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an <u>ongoing</u> noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I struggle to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I appreciate your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ongoing과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
ongoing = 진행 중인, 지속되는

✅ ② continuous(지속적인): ongoing과 동의어 ←정답

❌ ① occasional(가끔의): 간헐적이라는 의미로 ongoing과 반대

❌ ③ minor(사소한): 규모를 나타내는 단어로 의미 다름

❌ ④ resolved(해결된): 이미 끝났다는 의미로 ongoing과 반대

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I <u>struggle</u> to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I appreciate your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 struggle과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
struggle = 애쓰다, 힘겹게 하다

✅ ① strive(애쓰다): struggle과 동의어 ←정답

❌ ② refuse(거부하다): 노력이 아닌 거절의 의미

❌ ③ pretend(가장하다): 실제 어려움이 아닌 척하는 것

❌ ④ decide(결정하다): 의지적 선택으로 struggle과 다름

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I struggle to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I <u>appreciate</u> your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 appreciate과 의미가 가장 가까운 것은?

det.analysis:
appreciate = 감사하다, 고마워하다

✅ ④ value(소중히 여기다): appreciate과 동의어 ←정답

❌ ① ignore(무시하다): 감사의 반대

❌ ② demand(요구하다): 감사가 아닌 강요

❌ ③ doubt(의심하다): 감사와 무관
det.tip: appreciate ≈ value, be grateful for, be thankful for

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am <u>constantly</u> being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I struggle to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I appreciate your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 constantly과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
constantly = 끊임없이, 항상

✅ ③ rarely(드물게): constantly의 반의어 ←정답

❌ ① frequently(자주): constantly와 유사한 의미

❌ ② repeatedly(반복적으로): constantly와 유사한 의미

❌ ④ typically(전형적으로): 빈도가 아닌 방식을 나타냄

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is <u>affected</u> by this noise issue. I appreciate your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 affected과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.analysis:
affected = 영향받는

✅ ② unaffected(영향받지 않는): affected의 반의어 ←정답

❌ ① harmed(피해를 입은): affected와 유사한 의미

❌ ③ influenced(영향받는): affected와 동의어

❌ ④ concerned(관련된): affected와 유사한 의미

questions.passage:
(A) My apartment <u>faces</u> the basketball courts of the community center. The noise from the courts is unbearable at night.

(B) She washed her <u>face</u> with cold water every morning. It helped her feel refreshed and awake.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 face의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) ~을 향하다 / (B) 얼굴 ←정답

(A) 'My apartment faces the basketball courts'에서 face는 '~을 향하다'의 의미. 아파트가 농구 코트를 향하고 있다.

(B) 'She washed her face'에서 face는 '얼굴'의 의미. 매일 아침 찬물로 얼굴을 씻었다.

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"to limit or control the size, amount, or range of something"

det.korean: 무언가의 크기, 양, 범위를 제한하거나 통제하다
det.analysis:
정의: 'to limit or control the size, amount, or range of something' = 무언가의 크기, 양, 범위를 제한하거나 통제하다

✅ ④ restrict(제한하다): 정의와 정확히 일치 ←정답

❌ ① expand(확장하다): 제한의 반대

❌ ② appreciate(감사하다): 제한과 무관

❌ ③ inform(알리다): 정보 전달 의미로 제한과 다름

questions.passage: I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am __________. (experience)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 현재진행(be + -ing): 'I am'에 이어지므로 experience → experiencing. 현재 겪고 있는 상황을 나타내는 현재진행형.

questions.passage: I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I appreciate your __________. (assist)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.analysis: 명사형 변환: your 뒤에 명사가 와야 하므로 assist(돕다) → assistance(도움). 소유격(your) 다음에는 명사가 온다.

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support the community center's services, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 퀴즈 대회를 개최하다/잠들다/농구를 하다/이 편지를 읽다
det.analysis:
문맥: 많은 밤, 사람들이 공을 튀기고 소리치는 소리가 들려서 ____하기 위해 애쓴다.

✅ ② fall asleep(잠들다): 밤늦은 소음 때문에 잠들기 어렵다는 맥락에 적절 ←정답

❌ ① hosting a quiz night(퀴즈 대회 개최): 본문 내용과 무관

❌ ③ play basketball(농구하다): 필자가 아닌 다른 사람들의 행동

❌ ④ read this letter(편지 읽기): 소음 문제와 무관

questions.passage: To whom it may concern, I am writing to inform you of an ongoing noise issue that I am experiencing. My apartment faces the basketball courts of the community center. While I fully support __________, I am constantly being disrupted by individuals playing basketball late at night. Many nights, I struggle to fall asleep because I can hear people bouncing balls and shouting on the basketball courts well after 11 p.m. Could you restrict the time the basketball court is open to before 9 p.m.? I'm sure I'm not the only person in the neighborhood that is affected by this noise issue. I appreciate your assistance. Sincerely, Ian Baldwin
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 문화 센터의 서비스/농구 코트 일정/자기 아파트 가치/소음 문제 해결책
det.analysis:
문맥: '나는 ____을 전적으로 지지하지만, 밤늦게 농구하는 사람들로 인해 끊임없이 방해받고 있다.'

✅ ① the community center's services(문화 센터의 서비스): 서비스는 지지하지만 소음에는 불만이라는 대비 맥락 ←정답

❌ ② the basketball court's schedule(코트 일정): 지지 대상이 아님

❌ ③ his own apartment's value(아파트 가치): 맥락과 무관

❌ ④ the noise issue's solution(소음 해결책): 아직 요청 단계이므로 부자연스러움
det.tip: While I fully support ~, I am constantly being disrupted
